purpose: Complete one fixed lambda600 challenger and compare its final propagated Fig. 2 and Fig. 6 uncertainty with the immutable lambda1 incumbent before considering any further constraint trial.
required_order: finish and provenance-audit all 24 candidate starts
train the selected candidate central through its full requested horizon
finish and provenance-audit all 50 candidate experimental replicas
render candidate Fig. 2 and Fig. 6 plus explicit candidate-versus-incumbent comparisons
evaluate width improvement separately for u and d with the finite-ensemble allowance
only then decide whether another controlled trial is scientifically warranted
completion_semantics: Scientific stationarity or fit failures are recorded but do not truncate the requested 24-start, central, 50-replica, and final-figure evidence collection.
promotion_semantics: The candidate must pass coverage, provenance, fit preservation, FNP stationarity, band integrity, and robust full-width improvement separately for u and d. Start-only widths cannot promote it.
comparison_caveat: The lambda1 incumbent uses its historical training and replica protocol. Post-processing is harmonized, but the candidate also changes the reference-distance domain and fit-quality barrier, so this is a fixed incumbent replacement test rather than an assertion of fully identical training protocols.
